title: Islamic manners
intro: The right words for every moment – and good manners at the table.

learn.html: Islamic manners include saying the right words in different situations:

items.label: Bismillah – in the name of Allah – when we start something
InshaAllah – if Allah wills – when we hope for something
MashaAllah – what Allah wills – when we admire something
Subhanallah – glory be to Allah – when we are amazed
Alhamdulillah – praise be to Allah – in every situation
Yarhamukallah – may Allah have mercy on you – when someone sneezes
Ya Allah – O Allah – when we are in pain or trouble
Astaghfirullah – forgive me, O Allah – when we are sorry for a bad deed
Na‘udhu billah – we seek refuge in Allah – when we point out something bad

learn.title: ⭐ Learn these words
learn.html: Learn them and use them every day!

learn.text: Islamic manners when eating and drinking

items: wash the hands before and after eating
say A‘udhu billah and Bismillah, and eat with the right hand
don’t eat food that is too hot and don’t blow on it

questions.q: What do we say when we admire something?
What do we say when someone sneezes?
What do we say after eating?
Should we blow on hot food?

practice.title: Use them
prompts: 🗣️ Use these words every day this week – count how many times you say Alhamdulillah!
